subject: Outlier offer escalation: Sarika Desai (Principal, Inference)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Outlier offer escalation: Sarika Desai (Principal, Inference)

Team —

Quick context: Sarika (ex-quant infra lead at MeridianAI) has a competing executive-style package: higher base + aggressive RSU refresh. We ran an initial offer within band but she countered with another firm at 3 weeks and asked us to match to stay in process. Candidate is strong for the Principal Inference opening on my team and already gave verbal that Redwood is top choice if we can bridge the gap on sign-on and an equity top-up.

Request: permission to make an out-of-band package for a one-time sign-on + equity refresh. Attached: comp worksheet (numbers by band), draft offer, resume. Rough ask from recruiter: base $215k, sign-on $80k (one-time), equity refresh 0.55% (new grant on top of band).

My recommendation: move base to $210k (slightly above band mid), approve sign-on $65k, and a 0.40% refresh with standard 12-month clawback. Rationale: candidate critical for roadmap (LLM throughput + KV cache work), high risk of losing to competitor who can pay more base.

Ask for explicit approval on sign-on and equity refresh (and whether we want to bump base). If approved I will issue counter and request DocuSign.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi | Hiring Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: comp-worksheet-sarika-desai.pdf, offer-draft-sarika-v1.docx, resume-sarika-desai.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outlier offer escalation: Sarika Desai (Principal, Inference)

+1 to approving an exception but with tightened guardrails.

Irene — thanks for the clear note. After reviewing the comp worksheet and market comps for Principal inference hires in SF / remote-US, I support an exception limited to a one-time sign-on and equity refresh rather than permanently expanding base beyond band. Proposed final package:
- Base: $210,000 (approved; small above band but not full match)
- Sign-on: $70,000 (one-time, paid in 2 installments: 60% at start, 40% at 6 months)
- Equity refresh: 0.45% additional RSU grant, 4-year vest with 12-month clawback

Conditions: requires Finance acknowledgement of the one-time cash hit (Ben, can you confirm runway impact), and an HR-approved clawback clause in the offer language. If Finance signs off, we can greenlight and route the offer for signature.

Marissa
Sr. Total Rewards
